name: bet62-platform
description: BET62 - Plataforma completa de casino, pagamentos e gestão de conta

scripts.build: pnpm run prisma:generate:all && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.start:prod:all: pnpm run build && concurrently -k -n auth,wallet,odds,bonus,bets,casino,kyc,notif,user,admin,gateway,web -c red,green,yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,white,gray,boldRed,boldGreen,boldBlue,boldMagenta "pnpm --filter @bet62/auth-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/wallet-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/odds-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/bonus-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/bets-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/casino-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/kyc-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/notifications-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/user-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/admin-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/api-gateway run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/web run start"
scripts.start:railway: AUTH_PORT=3001 USER_PORT=3002 KYC_PORT=3003 WALLET_PORT=3004 ODDS_PORT=3005 BETS_PORT=3006 BONUS_PORT=3007 CASINO_PORT=3008 NOTIFICATIONS_PORT=3009 ADMIN_PORT=3010 WEB_PORT=3080 node infra/scripts/prisma-migrate-deploy-all.mjs && npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -m 0 -n auth,wallet,odds,bonus,bets,casino,kyc,notif,user,admin,gateway,web -c red.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold,blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold,white.bold,gray.bold,bgRed.white,bgGreen.white,bgBlue.white,bgMagenta.white "AUTH_PORT=3001 pnpm --filter @bet62/auth-service run start:prod" "WALLET_PORT=3004 pnpm --filter @bet62/wallet-service run start:prod" "ODDS_PORT=3005 pnpm --filter @bet62/odds-service run start:prod" "BONUS_PORT=3007 pnpm --filter @bet62/bonus-service run start:prod" "BETS_PORT=3006 pnpm --filter @bet62/bets-service run start:prod" "CASINO_PORT=3008 pnpm --filter @bet62/casino-service run start:prod" "KYC_PORT=3003 pnpm --filter @bet62/kyc-service run start:prod" "NOTIFICATIONS_PORT=3009 pnpm --filter @bet62/notifications-service run start:prod" "USER_PORT=3002 pnpm --filter @bet62/user-service run start:prod" "ADMIN_PORT=3010 pnpm --filter @bet62/admin-service run start:prod" "pnpm --filter @bet62/api-gateway run start:prod" "WEB_PORT=3080 pnpm --filter @bet62/web run start"
scripts.dev: pnpm run prisma:generate:all && concurrently -k -n auth,wallet,odds,bonus,bets,casino,kyc,notif,user,admin,gateway,web -c red,green,yellow,blue,magenta,cyan,white,gray,boldRed,boldGreen,boldBlue,boldMagenta "pnpm --filter @bet62/auth-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/wallet-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/odds-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/bonus-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/bets-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/casino-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/kyc-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/notifications-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/user-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/admin-service run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/api-gateway run dev" "pnpm --filter @bet62/web run dev"
